slides.title: Selling in Laval? Read these 5 numbers first
slides.sub: Fresh Centris data, sector by sector, in plain English.

slides.title: What Laval homes sold for
slides.body: The single-family median rose **5%** from a year ago. Your own price still depends on your street and house.

slides.title: More homes are competing with yours
slides.body: More choice for buyers than a year ago. That makes pricing and prep matter more for sellers.

slides.title: How long it took to sell
slides.body: Average days on market in Laval. Plan your move dates around your property type, not a guess.

slides.title: Your sector tells its own story
slides.body: Same city, different numbers. **Duvernay** houses sold in 27 days on average, **Chomedey** in 34.

slides.title: Price against solds, not listings
slides.body: Asking prices are hopes. Sold prices are facts. Look at all three for your street before you list.

slides.tagline: I'll give it to you straight, no arrogance, no fluff.
